description: This file contains unit tests for the BuzzPhotoController class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests various aspects of handling photo requests, including content type, headers, caching behavior, and response to non-existent or missing IDs.

classes.name: BuzzPhotoControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class testing the BuzzPhotoController's behavior with various photo requests.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test data by populating fixtures before any tests run.

methods.name: testHandle
methods.description: Tests handling a photo request with valid ID, verifying headers, content, and caching behavior.

methods.name: testHandleMultipleRequestWithoutETag
methods.description: Tests behavior when requesting another photo without an ETag, ensuring proper response.

methods.name: testHandleNonExistingPhotoId
methods.description: Tests response when requesting a non-existent photo ID.

methods.name: testHandleWithoutId
methods.description: Tests response when no ID is provided in the request.
